headline: Rams suffer several major injuries, including to WR Adams, who's out 6-10 weeks
summary: Rams wideout Davante Adams ruptured a hamstring in Sunday's loss to the Cardinals, and he will be sidelined for six to 10 weeks, coach Sean McVay announced.

headline: Commanders place starting RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) on IR
summary: The Washington Commanders placed running back Jacory Croskey-Merritt on injured reserve, sidelining their starting back for at least four games.

headline: Texans WR Tank Dell to play Sunday in 1st game since major 2024 knee injury
summary: Texans wide receiver Tank Dell will return to the field against the New York Giants on Sunday after a 22-month hiatus.

headline: What does firing GM Ballard mean for Colts coach Steichen?
summary: Carlie Irsay-Gordon made a big change Monday, but is it the first of many as the trade deadline nears?

headline: Jesse Minter: Lamar Jackson could "potentially" return to practice this week
summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson has missed two games with an ankle injury and head coach Jesse Minter didn't offer much clarity about his chances of returning for Week 7 during a Monday press conference.

headline: Lions’ Brian Branch, Cade Mays Expected To Play In Week 7
summary: On October 7, the Lions opened the practice window for safety Brian Branch and center Cade Mays. Both players are eligible to be activated at any time, and that should be taking place soon. “Barring anything negatively happening between now and the game, we plan on playing both of those guys,” head coach Dan Campbell said on Monday.
